excerpt_i18n.en: Chatbots today are everything machines. If it can be put into words—relationship advice, work documents, code—AI will produce it, however imperfectly. excerpt_i18n.en:
Currently, Agent is emerging as one of the most explosive directions in AI applications: capital is heavily invested, players are rushing to enter the field, and companies are racing to implement Agent, fearing to fall behind. According to IDC projections, the conservative estimate for the market size of enterprise-level Agent applications in China is set to reach $27 billion by 2028.

Amid the buzz, challenges in Agent implementation are gradually surfacing. On one hand, the breadth, depth, and efficiency of Agent task execution remain constrained by technical limitations; for instance, using multiple Agents to solve complex problems might require waiting half an hour or longer. On the other hand, issues such as model selection, identifying application scenarios, and Agent deployment are causing confusion for businesses.

With opportunities and challenges coexisting, vendors and players are constantly contemplating their roles in the Agent arena: some position themselves as full-stack AI service providers, leveraging AI and cloud infrastructure advantages for a comprehensive approach; others opt for strong partnerships to carve out a share of the Agent application market; and some focus on becoming specialized experts, aiming to secure a place in the Agent field through vertical domain expertise.

In this competitive landscape, early adopters are attempting to offer their interim insights. In the crowded Agent race, how can leading players break through? Globally, in the Agent domain, AI giants and major cloud providers are the two key players.
excerpt_i18n.es: Actualmente, los agentes se están convirtiendo en una de las direcciones más explosivas en aplicaciones de IA: el capital apuesta con fuerza, los participantes compiten por entrar y las empresas se apresuran a implementar agentes, temiendo quedarse atrás. Según las previsiones de IDC, se estima que el mercado de aplicaciones de agentes a nivel empresarial en China alcanzará de manera conservadora 270.000 millones de dólares en 2028. Bajo este bullicio, los desafíos en la implementación de agentes también están surgiendo. Por un lado, la amplitud, profundidad y eficiencia de las tareas ejecutadas por los agentes aún están limitadas por la tecnología; por ejemplo, resolver problemas complejos con múltiples agentes puede requerir esperar media hora o incluso más. Por otro lado, cuestiones como cómo seleccionar modelos, dónde están los escenarios de aplicación y cómo desplegar agentes se han convertido en dificultades para las empresas.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Recently, Leifeng Network learned that Tencent Cloud's B2B AI knowledge base product, Lexiang, saw a 100% increase in new orders this year, with the number of enterprises using its AI Q&A feature growing fourfold and AI interactions surging 22 times. It is surprising that such a traditional, niche enterprise tool achieved such significant order growth. After all, the enterprise knowledge base market is quite mature, having stabilized over a decade ago, with slow growth and limited willingness among companies to pay for what is often viewed as an internal management tool.

Why did Lexiang's orders surge this year? The key driver is the large model, which has sparked a new wave of enterprise AI knowledge base development. In the era of large models, knowledge bases are considered infrastructure. As Tang Daosheng, Senior Executive Vice President of Tencent Group, stated, large models are the "brain" and knowledge bases the "textbooks"; without relevant knowledge, even a highly intelligent model cannot solve problems effectively. Tencent Cloud Vice President Da Zhiqian noted that early this year, Tencent Cloud internally concluded that "large models + enterprise knowledge bases" would be the optimal path for AI implementation. Over the past several months, this assessment has been validated, with enterprise demand for knowledge bases exploding by three to five times after the advent of large models.

The enthusiasm for these knowledge bases is evident from participation in related activities.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Leifeng Wang supo que LeXiang, un producto de base de conocimientos de IA de Tencent Cloud dirigido al sector empresarial (to B), experimentó un crecimiento del 100% en nuevos pedidos este año, con un aumento de 4 veces en el número de empresas que utilizan su función de preguntas y respuestas de IA y un incremento de 22 veces en la frecuencia de uso de esta función. Es sorprendente que una herramienta empresarial tan tradicional y especializada logre un avance tan significativo en pedidos. Cabe recordar que las bases de conocimientos empresariales son un campo muy maduro, establecido hace más de una década, con un crecimiento de mercado desacelerado, y además, a menudo se perciben como herramientas de gestión interna, lo que limita la disposición de las empresas a pagar por ellas. ¿Por qué se dispararon los pedidos de LeXiang este año? El auge en el negocio de los proveedores de bases de conocimientos este año es generalizado.
